notes:
Quick notes / call snippets:
- Company: DiffSage builds a GitHub-style PR review assistant + IDE copilot focused on mid-size engineering teams. Core product: browser/GH app + VS Code plugin.
- Primary asks: low-latency streaming for inline comment suggestions, deterministic model/version pinning for reproducible diffs, reranking of candidate comments, and cost predictability for heavy snapshot diffs.
- Perf targets: stream token latency <120ms for single-file diffs, end-to-end summary <=1s for <300-line diffs; sustained throughput ~200-300 PRs/day for flagship repo.
- Security: must support SSO (SAML), SOC2 evidence, audit logs, KMS integration; VPC peering for private repo access. Data residency preference: NA only for enterprise customers.
- POC setup: two repos (backend and infra), mix of small and large PRs. Running hosted API baseline + dedicated quantized nodes. Early results: summary quality is good, but reranker recall needs tuning; streaming lat spikes when multiple files open in parallel.
- Quote from CTO (Parth Mehta): "We need deterministic outputs for our compliance checks — pinning is non-negotiable. Also want fallback when cloud capacity is hit."
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay premium for SLA but needs predictable per-PR cost model. Ask: token-level breakdown and batching trade-offs.
- Integration notes: will install Redwood GitHub app in staging org, want a VS Code extension example and a `/review` API for reuse. Interested in per-repo routing policies and automatic fallback to cheaper quantized variants for non-critical repos.
- Next tacticals: complete perf run with quantized dedicated nodes, provide sample cost projection (token-level & per-PR), deliver SOC2 artifact bundle.
- Sales note: heavy influence from engineering (CTO + Head of Infra). Procurement contact identified but not responsive yet.
